children: Douglas Elliman Chief Financial Officer James Kirkland III is retiring, effective immediately.
Kirkland and the company mutually agreed that he would retire, according to a Friday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The company appointed Heather Capriola as his successor.
The company and General Counsel Bradley Brodie also mutually agreed that Brodie will step down and be succeeded by Deva Roberts, according to the filing.
Both Capriola and Roberts' appointments are effective immediately.

Kirkland and Brodie both agreed to separation agreements with the company that will release it from claims in exchange for severance pay and accelerated vesting of certain shares, among other benefits and payments.
